# pltr commands

Find commands: search, list and show the manifest of every pltr command.

The manifest describes every command, curated and generated (pltr api): its arguments and options, whether it is beta, destructive or paged, its output formats and the SDK method it calls. To find and run a command: search, show its entry, then run it with --format json.

    Examples:
        pltr commands search list dataset branches
        pltr commands search Dataset.Branch.list
        pltr commands show dataset get --format json
        pltr commands list api datasets
        pltr commands list --format json > manifest.json

3 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr commands list

List every command; with --format json, print the whole manifest.

`pltr commands list [PATH...] [OPTIONS]`

- `PATH...` (optional): Only commands under this path, e.g. `dataset` or `api datasets`.
- local (no Foundry call)

### pltr commands search

Search commands by name, description and SDK method, best match first.

`pltr commands search TEXT... [OPTIONS]`

- `TEXT...`: What to look for: words (list dataset branches), a command path, or an SDK method (Dataset.Branch.list).
- `--limit`, `-n` INTEGER (default: 10): Maximum number of results.
- local (no Foundry call)

### pltr commands show

Show one command's manifest entry: usage, arguments, options and more.

`pltr commands show COMMAND... [OPTIONS]`

- `COMMAND...`: The command's path: dataset get, "dataset get" or "pltr dataset get".
- local (no Foundry call)
